ASITUBE / SITE INFORMATION

Privacy

Last updated: 21 September 2026.

A small digital footprint

This homepage uses no analytics, advertising pixels, cookies, browser storage, embedded videos, accounts, or contact forms. The animated artwork and story choices run in your browser. Choices exist only in page memory and reset when you reload or leave. All website assets are served from the same website.

Hosting

The website is hosted on GitHub Pages. GitHub receives the technical request information needed to serve the site, including your IP address. We do not maintain a separate visitor analytics database. Read the GitHub General Privacy Statement for information about its processing and retention.

External links and contact

YouTube, ASimulation, and other external services are contacted when you follow their links. Their own privacy practices apply. The email contact link opens your email application; this website does not send an email or store a message.

Operator and enquiries

ASITube is a Metaversal Arts project. Operator and contact details are available in the Metaversal Arts legal notice. For privacy questions, contact contact@metaversalarts.io. The operator’s privacy information describes contact correspondence and your data-protection rights.
